name: Item randomizer
author: Flavius
description: Shuffles what the game gives out (Ratchet & Clank, and Going Commando's NTSC-U v1.01 disc): the gadgets and weapons from NPCs and pickups, the vendor's weapons, the gold bolts and the infobots' coordinates, so each seed is a new route through the game. Every seed can be finished: what you need is only ever placed where you can get it without it. Share a seed's code and a friend plays the same game. Each seed writes a spoiler log to the mod's data folder. A save made with a seed belongs to that seed.

settings.name: Seed
settings.description: A seed code to play a shared game (it carries its settings), or any word. Blank: a random seed, rolled once and kept for your next starts (the log and the spoiler log show its code).

settings.name: Logic
settings.description: Standard: what you need is never behind a very expensive purchase, and each place is expected to be done with the weapons the game suggests there. Relaxed: what you need also comes early in the game, and never behind a purchase you have to save up for. Expert: what you need may be behind any purchase, even the most expensive, and you get by with any weapon.

settings.name: Shuffle gadgets
settings.description: The gadgets NPCs and pickups give: the Swingshot, the Heli-Pack, the Magneboots, ... Going Commando: the Dynamo, the Swingshot, the Grindboots, Clank's packs, the Thermanator, the Glider, the Gravity Boots, ...

settings.name: Shuffle weapons
settings.description: The weapons NPCs and pickups give: the Suck Cannon, the Morph-o-Ray, the R.Y.N.O. Going Commando: the Sheepinator.

settings.name: Shuffle the vendor
settings.description: Ratchet & Clank: each weapon the Gadgetron vendor sells is a slot that gives something else when bought, at the slot's price. Going Commando: each weapon the vendor sells comes on sale from another planet.

settings.name: Shuffle gold bolts
settings.description: Gold bolts join the pool: a gold bolt may be anywhere, and a gold bolt's place may hold a weapon or a useful extra, never something you need to go on.

settings.name: Shuffle infobots
settings.description: The planets' coordinates the infobots give join the pool.

settings.name: Show what the vendor gives
settings.description: A line above the picture says what buying a weapon at the vendor gives you. Off: buying is a surprise.

settings.name: Keep the starting gear
settings.description: Start with the Bomb Glove, as the game does. Off: what Veldin gives at the start is shuffled too.

settings.name: Spoiler log
settings.description: Write where everything is, and a way through, to the mod's data folder.
